lore.summary: Kat receives a complete-in-box purple Japanese Game Boy Pocket, already has pink, and considers collecting the basic-color hardware set; Pocket remains monochrome, not Game Boy Color.

speaker.basis: Named hosts and dialogue continuity, not audio verification.

evidence.quote: purple Ken Pleaton box Game Boy pocket from Japan
I already have the pink one

speaker.basis: Named hosts and dialogue continuity, not audio verification.

speaker.basis: Named hosts and dialogue continuity, not audio verification.

evidence.quote: I think I have a gold pocket from Japan
a teal and a yellow one
Europe or Australia I believe I’m not sure

speaker.basis: Named hosts and dialogue continuity, not audio verification.

probably would be the two Final Fantasies and Chrono Trigger

review_queue.reason: Raw VVVVVVV conflicts with spoken fiveVs; digitalDS/3DS wording uncertain. Do not infer exact physical edition availability.
Brawl is used in a WiiU-additions hypothetical; do not silently relabel it or verify platform history.
John is Kat's husband, not Johnny. Joint events use Kat plus co_subjects; reported poster owner differs from reporter.
Gold Pocket pack-in Europe/Australia and Johnny's hardware colors are tentative source claims.

All annual counts, prices, dates and game totals are self-reported; lot allocations not market values; overlapping aggregates not summed.

evidence.quote: divide the cost over those 30 games equally

review_queue.reason: Photo project, purchases, shelving and under365 target are future/open, not completed events.

unidentified_acquisitions.description: Annual totals and recent Wii bulk acquisitions lack per-game enumeration and may overlap each other; never sum as disjoint events.

Collecting goals and intended repurchases are not fulfilled acquisitions.
